answer: Score an agent's trust by the diversity of its counterparties, not its volume. An honest agent weaves a broad trellis of links to many independent peers, while a sybil cluster only trades inward, forming a tight island whose edges never reach the wider graph. Weight influence by cross-cluster, ferrous-strong external ties that are costly to forge, and an operator's clones collapse into a single low-diversity node earning the voice of one.
